name: Convo API
description:
The Convo API gives your code the sales calls Convo records: transcripts, key points, coaching feedback, follow-up emails, contact briefings and webhooks. Build integrations with Zapier, Make or your own applications.

## Authentication
Send `Authorization: Bearer convo_...` with a key created in the Convo desktop app under **Settings → Convo API**. Keys work on Starter, Professional and Enterprise plans.

## Plans
| | Starter | Professional | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|
| API keys | 1 | 3 | 10 |
| Requests per hour | 100 | 500 | 2,000 |
| AI credits per month | 1,500 | 15,000 | 30,000 |
| Webhooks | No | 3 | 999 |
| Contacts (Convo Memory) | No | With Memory | With Memory |

The desktop app's AI features use the same credits. See https://docs.itsconvo.com/tiers.

## Rate limits
Successful responses carry `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset`. Over the hourly limit you get `429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After`.
